scope_note: Thirty-three residual modeled syntheses remain after the second adversarial continuation. They retain published Deloitte/Google IMPLAN channels as source-modeled outputs, the lower-bound payroll annualization, six exact annual paid-tax aggregations, six same-period equal-cost identities, and one sensitivity-qualified descriptive county wage comparison. Employment and GDP county gaps remain retired because sign stability and pre-period-fit gates fail. Assessor-generator, permit-potential, permit-runtime, fee-input and billable-emissions quantities are encoded in the single machine-actionable adoption proposal because the current catalog lacks correctly scoped metrics or units. The models do not allocate campus/state results to the selected building, invent supplier spend/payroll/public costs, convert workers to job-years, estimate incentives or net fiscal impact, or treat source projections as actuals.

assumptions: No allocation to the selected inventory building.
No aggregation with another estimate unless explicitly declared.

limitations: Not pollutant-resolved and not interchangeable with facility potential-to-emit ceilings.

Nonadditive across pollutants and not allocated to engines, permit groups, buildings, load, or production.
